dedupe_keys.name: gnss scintillation and tec data at skibotn norway 2014 to 2023 university of oslo

description: This dataset holds GNSS scintillation and total electron content data from a GPS Ionospheric Scintillation and TEC Monitor (GISTM, model GSV4004) at Skibotn in northern Norway, below the auroral oval, from 2014 to 2023; the receiver was first installed at the Blindern campus in Oslo and moved to Skibotn in September 2014. It contains the standard one-minute phase and amplitude scintillation indices and TEC calibrated with the GPS-SCINDA software, with yearly zip files of daily CSV observation files, a data availability figure, a README with usage suggestions and a link to daily quick-look plots. It was published by Yaqi Jin of the University of Oslo on DataverseNO in 2024 (version 1.0) and is accessible free under CC0 1.0. Caveats: the receiver was not operated continuously and has breaks in summer, it covers a single station and only GPS signals, and users must handle calibration and multipath filtering themselves. It supports validation of GNSS scintillation and positioning-degradation models for high-latitude navigation, aviation and precision services during geomagnetic storms; a related record is the University of Bergen Svalbard GNSS scintillation and TEC data.
name: GNSS scintillation and TEC data at Skibotn, Norway, 2014 to 2023 (University of Oslo)
notes: The related University of Bergen Svalbard record exists only on the integrator branch, so it is named in the description and not linked.
